notes: PAP reference G50/1509. Whole four-room duplex in Tours' Michelet district, on the second and top floor of a six-lot coproperty. The complete advert describes an entrance with storage, 33 m2 south-facing living and dining room, fitted kitchen, first 15 m2 bedroom with storage and bathroom/WC on the main level; upstairs are two further 15 m2 and 17 m2 bedrooms, storage and an 8 m2 shower room with separate WC. Two cellars are included. The advert explicitly discloses that there is no parking or balcony, says the property and coproperty require no work, and states individual gas heating and EUR 140 monthly charges including water. The live text contains no tenant, lease, occupied-sale or delayed-vacancy wording. PAP exposed 12 property photos and a publication date of 24 September 2026. No lift is asserted because the advert does not expose one.

PAP reference G41/1695. Whole two-room attic apartment with 53 m2 Carrez and approximately 64 m2 floor area in Tours' central Halles district, on the second floor of a small coproperty. The complete advert describes a bright living area with sitting and office spaces, functional open kitchen and bar, spacious bedroom, shower room with WC, extensive storage and a 2 m2 storeroom. Electric heating and DPE C are explicit. The advert notes that an optional partition could create an additional small bedroom, but the current two-room and one-bedroom configuration is retained. The live text contains no tenant, lease, occupied-sale or delayed-vacancy wording. PAP exposed 9 property photos and a publication date of 17 September 2026. No lift is asserted because the advert does not expose one.
